summary: Receives DMX, Art-Net, sACN, or KiNET data as CHOP channels, with serial, network, filtering, packet-format, queue, and resampling controls.
key_concepts: Receives DMX, Art-Net, sACN, or KiNET into CHOP channels, with DMX channel values in the 0-255 range and physical DMX refresh limited to about 44 Hz.
Interface selects the protocol or device path, while Format determines whether packets become time-sliced samples or packet-per-channel Latest/All outputs.
Art-Net Net, Subnet, and Universe are protocol address fields, not IP networking fields; sACN universe 0 is reserved by the system.
A Filter Table can restrict packet-per-channel Art-Net or sACN reception by net, subnet, universe, and optional single-IP source/destination filters.
Queue Size smooths Art-Net or sACN packet arrival at the cost of latency, and Rate resamples incoming data for downstream CHOP timing.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Connect to the selected device or network interface

key_params.name: interface
key_params.note: Enttec serial/USB, Art-Net, sACN, or KiNET

key_params.name: serialport
key_params.note: Serial COM port for generic serial mode

key_params.name: net
key_params.note: Art-Net net address, not an IP address

key_params.name: filterdat
key_params.note: Filter table for packet-per-channel Art-Net or sACN

key_params.name: rate
key_params.note: Resample incoming data to this rate

common_gotchas: DMX channel values are 0-255 and physical DMX refresh is limited to about 44 Hz.
Art-Net net and subnet parameters are protocol addresses, not IP network or subnet-mask fields.
Filter table srcaddress and destaddress cells expect single IP addresses; pattern matching is not supported.
Queue Size can smooth packet arrival but adds latency and may create more packets per cook in All mode.
Use Wireshark or ENTTEC NMU when diagnosing Art-Net, DMX, or ENTTEC device discovery problems.
